question.problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n}{2}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n}{2}x)
$$

The Fourier series of the $4\pi $-periodic extension $f(x)$ of the function 

$$
F(x)=\{\begin{aligned}5, & x\in [0,2\pi ) \\ -2, & x\in [-2\pi ,0)\end{aligned}
$$

is shown above. Find the exact value of ${b}_{3}.$

${b}_{3}=$ {{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the sine coefficients are given by

$$
{b}_{n}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{L}x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=2\pi .$ Also, $f(x)=5$ for $x\in [0,2\pi )$ and $f(x)=-2$ for $x\in [-2\pi ,0).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{b}_{3} & =\frac{1}{2\pi }{\int }_{-2\pi }^{2\pi }f(x)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3}{2}x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2\pi }{\int }_{-2\pi }^{0}(-2)\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3}{2}x)\,\text{d}x+\frac{1}{2\pi }{\int }_{0}^{2\pi }5\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{3}{2}x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =-\frac{2}{2\pi }\cdot (-\frac{2}{3}){[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3}{2}x)]}_{-2\pi }^{0}+\frac{5}{2\pi }\cdot (-\frac{2}{3}){[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{3}{2}x)]}_{0}^{2\pi } \\  & =\frac{2}{3\pi }(\operatorname{cos}⁡(0)-\operatorname{cos}⁡(-3\pi ))-\frac{5}{3\pi }(\operatorname{cos}⁡(3\pi )-\operatorname{cos}⁡(0)) \\  & =\frac{2}{3\pi }(1-(-1))-\frac{5}{3\pi }((-1)-1) \\  & =\frac{4}{3\pi }+\frac{10}{3\pi } \\  & =\frac{14}{3\pi }.\end{aligned}
$$
